data.body: **[P2] Accept independently verified worker retirement as settlement.** A worker retired without Python cleanup never emits either wrapper-exit event. Even when the deadline test establishes full capacity recovery in the original environment, this predicate remains false. Teardown then fails permanently, and `configuration['pending']` blocks subsequent cases. Carry request/process-correlated retirement evidence into settlement alongside wrapper exits, while continuing to reject unproven termination. Cover retirement without a final wrapper diagnostic.
